mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and dehydration may potentiate morphine's hypotensive effects and increase risk of orthostasis and CNS depression; morphine may mask symptoms of electrolyte imbalance.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes, and renal function; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic if morphine doses are high; counsel patient on fall risk and orthostatic precautions.
